title: Sweep, displace, retrace
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The Daily and 4H have been trending up. Use them for bias, then look at the 5m for a way in once price has done something at the open.
intro.advanced: 09:50 ET. Mark what matters and decide.

whyNot.label: the bearish 5m gap at 09:55
whyNot.why: It formed inside the pullback, against the displacement. A gap in the opposite direction after a sweep and displacement is a retrace, not a signal.

whyNot.label: buying at market now
whyNot.why: Price has already left the entry area. The edge was in the gap the displacement left, not 30 points above it.

reference.summary: Bullish higher timeframes, sell-side liquidity swept at the open, displacement through the last 5m high, and a retrace into the gap it left, with the previous day high as the draw.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are making higher highs and higher lows, and the overnight dip into a 1H gap was a pullback inside that trend.

options.note: A pullback can look like indecision, but nothing broke the trend

decision.why: A sweep, displacement and an entry area with a clear draw is a valid long. Waiting for price to return into the gap is just as sound; chasing it is not.

draw.why: The previous day high is the obvious pool above, and displacement points straight at it.

take.why: This has liquidity taken, displacement, a defined entry and a draw.

annotations.label: Overnight low 21,232.75
annotations.why: Obvious sell-side liquidity, and exactly where the open swept it.
annotations.decisionNote: The sweep is the trigger. Without it this is just a long in a trend.

annotations.label: Previous day high 21,377.5
annotations.why: The pool above and the draw: stops resting over yesterday's high.
annotations.decisionNote: Sets the target, and with the entry sets whether the trade clears 2R.

annotations.label: Sweep low 21,223.5
annotations.why: The extreme of the sweep. If it breaks the idea is wrong, so this is the stop reference.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: The displacement candle left a gap and closed through the last 5m high. A retrace into it is the entry model.
annotations.decisionNote: The edge is in the retrace. A fill here is a better price and a shorter stop than anything after the move.

annotations.label: 5m order block under the gap
annotations.why: The last down candle before the displacement. An acceptable alternative area, sitting below the gap.

annotations.label: 1H bullish FVG the sweep ran into
annotations.why: The sweep took the low inside a 1H gap: higher-timeframe support under the whole idea.

annotations.label: 5m bearish FVG at 09:55
annotations.why: A gap against the move, left by the retrace. It looks like a setup and is just the pullback.
annotations.whyNot: A gap that forms against displacement is a retrace, not a reason to trade it.

annotations.label: Asia high 21,378.75
annotations.why: Real, but the overnight range sat below it and nothing here depends on it.

confluences.label: Sell-side liquidity (overnight low) swept
confluences.why: Liquidity taken is the reason there was something to buy.

confluences.label: Displacement closing above the last 5m high
confluences.why: Structure shifted after the sweep; that is the confirmation.

confluences.label: Entry area is the displacement's FVG
confluences.why: A defined area to buy with a close stop.

confluences.label: Daily and 4H trending up
confluences.why: The trade goes with the higher timeframe.

confluences.label: Inside the NY AM window
confluences.why: Moves that start here have the volume to travel.

confluences.label: Bearish 5m FVG at 09:55
confluences.why: A pullback gap against the move; it changes nothing.

confluences.label: The 21,300 round number
confluences.why: A round number is not a reason to buy or sell.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed above the last 5m high

lookFor: Liquidity taken, then displacement that closes through a recent swing: in that order.
Take the entry from the gap the displacement left, not from a market order after the move.
Name the draw before you enter: here, the previous day high.

provenance.note: Constructed price path, not market history.
